summary.headline: Mercury in the Earth Signs
summary.text: Astrological predictions for Mercury’s entry into Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius, and Capricorn, covering weather, food, markets, rulers, diseases, social unrest, and regional effects. Hermes, Sanjari, and Hasib Kay offer differing observations about clouds, rain, winds, waters, and air.
